subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw accept `question.*`, `operator.questions`, and the public question-resolution SDK subpath as the provider-neutral long-term human-input contract after the two concrete runtime repairs?
rationale: This is a new durable protocol and plugin-facing capability spanning channels, native clients, and the Control UI; a review worker cannot determine the intended permanent public contract from correctness evidence alone.

options.title: Accept the shared contract after repair
options.body: Keep the provider-neutral runtime, fix the two P2 paths, and merge after the owner confirms the Gateway and SDK API are the intended stable seam.

options.title: Narrow the surface first
options.body: Keep the user-facing tool work but defer or reduce the public Gateway or Plugin SDK exposure until a smaller contract is agreed.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the provider-neutral layer if maintainers do not want to own this cross-channel protocol commitment now.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared contract after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-neutral runtime, fix the two P2 paths, and merge after the owner confirms the Gateway and SDK API are the intended stable seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and this branch establish the strongest available ownership trail for the question-runtime design.
